teacher.name: Hilde
teacher.title: the miner
teacher.learnLine: Take my old pick. Bring me copper and we'll talk.
teacher.kinLine: A miner's {son|daughter|child}, I'd know it anywhere. You know which end of a pick goes in the rock, {name}. Keep my old one.

tips.title: Bones under the hills
tips.text: "Dug up a skeleton once. Still had its mail on. Blades just skate off that stuff. Bring a hammer, or a mace."

tips.title: Troll skin
tips.text: "Trolls are all hide and no iron. A good edge opens them up like a sack of grain."

tips.title: Living rock
tips.text: "A golem is just a vein that walks. You don't cut rock, and you don't poke it. You break it."

teacher.name: Bram
teacher.title: the woodcutter
teacher.learnLine: Here, my old hatchet. Mind the goblins when you're in the oaks.
teacher.greeting: Mind the goblins in the oaks, {name}.
teacher.kinLine: {name}! You swing like one of us. Keep the old hatchet; it knows you.

tips.title: The old one
tips.text: "That bear's coat turns an axe like oak bark. A spear finds the gap between the ribs."

tips.title: Webs in the arches
tips.text: "Spiders wear their bones outside, hard as boiled leather. Point first, {lad|lass|friend}. Never the edge."

tips.title: Feathers on the pass
tips.text: "Harpies are feathers and spite, nothing to stop a blade. Swing wide and they come apart."

teacher.name: Wen
teacher.title: the fisherman
teacher.learnLine: Take my old rod. Bring me back some fish.
teacher.kinLine: A coast {lad|lass|friend}! Salt in your hair, {name}. Take my old rod; you'll not need telling how.

tips.title: Mirror Lake
tips.text: "Perch bite all day at Mirror Lake. One in five is a pike, and now and then a golden carp. Something old and green rolls out there at dawn. We call him Old Mossback."

tips.title: Under the bridge
tips.text: "Brown trout hold under Troll Bridge, and eels, one in five. A silver salmon, if you're lucky. The trolls say a river king lives under the middle arch. Trolls lie, mostly."

tips.title: Smugglers' Cove
tips.text: "So the chart was true. Sea bass off the rocks, mackerel one in five, a moonfish now and then. The old smugglers swore by a fish with one eye, big as a man. And by a chest they lost off the jetty."

tips.title: The cold tarn
tips.text: "Arctic char in the cold tarn, and frostfin, one in five. Glacier pike, if you're patient. Something pale moves deep under the ice. I don't fish there alone."

teacher.name: Sigrun
teacher.title: the hunter
teacher.learnLine: My old bow. Walk soft, aim low, and never follow a golden stag past dusk.
teacher.kinLine: You walk like one of mine, {name}. Soft. The old bow is yours.

tips.title: Goblin hide
tips.text: "Brutes wear goblin hide and nothing else. An edge does the work; just don't let it get its arms round you."

tips.title: The deer trail
tips.text: "Red deer feed along the deer trail. One track in four is a wild boar's. And they say a golden stag walks there at dusk. Few hunters ever see it, fewer bring home its antler."

tips.title: Thin pelt
tips.text: "I've skinned a hundred wolves. Thin pelt over lean meat. Cut, don't poke."

tips.title: Tracks on the moor
tips.text: "Moor elk graze the Grey Moor, with black boar among them, one in four. The herders talk of Old Tusk, a boar as big as a cart. Nobody I know has brought back his tusk."

tips.title: Roof tiles
tips.text: "Wyvern scales lie like roof tiles. Swing and you slide off. Find the seam with a point."

tips.title: Up in the crags
tips.text: "Ibex climb the crags above the pass, and snow grouse nest there, one in four. Watch the snow for a lynx's print. I've seen one, once. Its pelt is worth a season."

teacher.name: Garrow
teacher.title: the smith
teacher.learnLine: My old hammer still rings true. Any forge will do: strike while it's hot.
teacher.greeting: Forge is hot, {name}. What are we making?
teacher.kinLine: Burns on your hands and soot in your ears. Another smith, {name}. Any forge will do.

tips.title: Soft as wet clay
tips.text: "Zombies wear nothing but rot. Any blade I make you will go clean through."

tips.title: Stolen leather
tips.text: "Bandits wear studded leather they didn't pay for. The rivets stop a blade; a spear point slips past them."

tips.title: Cold mail
tips.text: "The wraiths still wear the mail they died in. Blades skid off the rings; a spear point goes between them."

teacher.name: Marta
teacher.title: the cook
teacher.learnLine: Here's my old pot. Bring me fish and meat, and I'll show you what a fire is for.
teacher.kinLine: Another tavern cook! Don't scorch my pot, {name}. Bring fish and meat and we'll feed this whole camp.
